about: Every record the second pass of the district checks moved (data/local/REPORT.md section 34: the matcher fix and the newly tested records, Michigan 2022, the states' and a county's results, Vermont 2018, DC 2018's at-large seats, Virginia's notes, D2's governor totals): the working tree after the rebuild against the branch before it (the commit named in 'against', the code alone; its data are main's at 78a82f2), stamps aside. Listed one by one: every record whose p was lost, gained or retyped, whose reason or note changed, or whose p moved by more than 1%. The records whose p moved by 1% or less, and nothing else but their forecasts, are counted by level and year in p_moved_within_1pct: the fits and the chambers' leans gain the districts whose p returns, so every p fitted on them moves a little. D2's governor and House records are not in this list: their p did not move (data/congress/check-totals.json lists them).
